about: The queue of the whole-suite runs of this user, as `qargi suite status` shows it: the slot (`state`), the run that holds it (`holder`) and the runs that wait for it, in the order they will be served. A whole-suite run (feature verify, release verify, `suite run`) holds the slot only while its suite runs, so two never overlap on one host. `state` is `free` (nobody holds the slot), `held` (a lock is held; `holder` names the run when its record is there and its process is alive, else it is null) or `unknown` (the lock cannot be read from /proc/locks and no live record names a holder); the state is read from the kernel's lock table, never from the records alone, so a holder that was killed is not shown. `waiting` lists only the runs whose process is alive. A field read from a file in the queue directory is cut to plain characters. The verb exits 0 with a document and prints nothing else on standard output; a queue that cannot be read is exit 1 with one line on standard error and no document, a document that fails the check of this registry file is exit 70 with one line on standard error and no document, and a wrong call is exit 2.
writes: Nothing: the queue directory is only read (a waiter file of a process that is gone is not removed), no lock is taken, no token is made and no process is signalled.

state.description: Whether a run holds the slot: see `about`.

holder.description: The run that holds the slot; null when nobody does, or when the lock is held and its record is missing or names a process that is gone.

waiting.description: The runs that wait, first served first; empty when none does.

pid.description: The process that holds the lock: the shell of the verb that runs the suite.

project.description: The stored project of the run; null for a `suite run` outside any project.

name.description: The feature, the version, or the command (its first word) of a `suite run`.

head.description: The commit the suite runs on; null for a `suite run`.

age_seconds.description: Whole seconds since the run took the slot.

position.description: 1 for the run that is served next.

pid.description: The process that waits: the shell of the verb.

waiting_seconds.description: Whole seconds since it began to wait.
